Pulled low, it resets the chip
STM32F103C8 (some are clones: CKS32, GD32), seen from above, the SWD header on the right. Pins at 3.3 V; most take 5 V as inputs (but the analog ones). The LED is on PC13.
WeAct\'s STM32F411CE (or F401CC), seen from above, the SWD header on the right. Pins at 3.3 V. The LED is on PC13, the KEY button on PA0; BOOT0 is a button, BOOT1 is PB2.
